description: Functional refactoring suggestions (light bulb quick fixes) for F#, built on FSharp.Analyzers.SDK. Over 130 rules covering correctness, performance, idiom and redundancy; every one is Hint severity, so they never gate a build.
releaseNotes:
0.8.46: FR0182 checks a lambda's pattern parameter against the lambda's body and stays quiet where the scope holds an `#if`. A test file is also recognised by a qualified or non-first test attribute; FR0092 finds a C# test pinning a failure message and leaves the message alone.

 0.8.45: New rule FR0182 (idiom, fix): a local `id` read once hides FSharp.Core's identity function; renamed to `pid`. Fixes that add, rename or move a name no longer rebind another one (FR0071, FR0103, FR0150, FR0120, FR0118, FR0012, FR0092, FR0160, FR0133, FR0095, FR0046, FR0181, FR0006, FR0157, FR0172): a name already in scope, rebound before the call or brought in by an `open` holds the fix, or the next free name is taken. An `open` inside a nested module no longer counts for code outside it (FR0041, FR0139, FR0174, FR0106, FR0005 and the namespace-spelling fixes).

 0.8.44:FR0101 gives nested index loops over different collections different element names (both took `item`, the inner one shadowing the outer). FR0164 reads the target runtime: `Dictionary.Remove`/`Clear` pass from .NET Core 3.0, an indexer overwrite and `HashSet.Remove`/`Clear` from .NET 5; on .NET Framework and netstandard all of them are reported. FR0092 leaves a message a test embeds in a longer string.

 0.8.43: Visual Studio extension bundles FsAutoComplete 0.85.3, whose quick fixes are titled by what they write. VS Code extension offers to install or update the `fsautocomplete` tool when Ionide's is older than 0.85.

 0.8.42: FR0075 counts a window the scope does not show modally (`form.Show()`, `Application.Run form`, a method of its own that shows it) as self-active: a `use` there disposed the window on the spot (C# twin CR0060).

 0.8.41: New rules FR0175 (date format `hh`/`mm`/`MM` mix-ups, fix), FR0176 (date parts from two instants, fix), FR0177 (always-true/false comparison pair), FR0178 (`.Value` in the empty branch), FR0179 (discarded immutable update), FR0180 (`Random` per call to `Random.Shared`, fix), FR0181 (specific catch around a blocking wait). FR0067 covers `Convert.To*` on a string, FR0017 `let _ = asyncCall`, FR0127 credential-named literals; reports mask credential findings. FR0049 accepts a read behind a bounded `Task.WaitAny`. Faster sweeps: files are no longer typechecked twice, and the project-wide use list is built once. `--api-changes` reads a referencing project only when its sources name the declaration.
